Title: Children’s Garden at Kew Gardens
Address: Kew Gardens, Kew, Richmond (nearest entrances: Elizabeth Gate and Brentford Gate)
DaysOfWeek: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
ScheduleText: Open daily with the Gardens; autumn/winter 10:00–16:00 (last entry 15:00). Included in Kew Gardens entry
PriceText: Child (4–15) £2–£4; adult £17–£28, or £10 on Tuesdays until 29 Dec 2026
Description: Outdoor play area the size of 40 tennis courts with Earth, Air, Sun and Water gardens: climbing, balancing, a 4 m high canopy walk round a 200-year-old oak, and more than 100 trees
